purpose: Record the provisional induction that (*|*) is the primitive distinction form and that A|E is its canonical dominant-domain realization under whole-expression governance.

governance_position.rule: This induction is clarification-only at the induction layer.
governance_position.non_promotion_clause: It may not be used to promote theorems, close proof dependencies, or claim a settled ontology.
forbidden_readings: A|E is assembled from independently primitive components
A|E is merely derivative and therefore non-primitive

induction.preferred_reading: (*|*) is the primitive distinction form. A|E is the canonical realization of that form within the dominant organizational domain.
induction.whole_expression_rule: A|E is primitive only as a whole expression within its dominant domain; A alone, E alone, and | alone are not primitive.

fit_assessment.reason: This induction reinforces existing whole-expression primacy, anti-reification, and relation-conditioned reading constraints already present in the governed program.

required_followup.textbook_patch: Applied in Chapter 1.2A and Appendix F.8 as provisional clarification only.
